te: The Great Fire of Meireki begins in Edo (now Tokyo), Japan, causing more than 100,000 deaths before it exhausts itself …
dz: 明历大火始于日本江户（现东京），造成超过 100,000 人死亡，三天后才熄灭。
de: The Great Fire of Meireki begins in Edo (now Tokyo), Japan, causing more than 100,000 deaths before it exhausts itself three days later.
